name: External browser click
description: Clicks an element by CSS selector in the temporary Peer-managed Chromium session.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 在临时 Peer 托管 Chromium 中按 CSS 选择器点击元素。
localizedDescription.en-US: Clicks an element by CSS selector in the temporary Peer-managed Chromium session.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click (first match). Supports optional frame:N prefix.
